description: Sets (or clears, if designSystemId is omitted/empty) the active Open Design design system, persisted for this workspace. Used automatically by prepare_open_design_brief whenever called without an explicit designSystemId.

designSystemId.description: A design system id from list_open_design_design_systems. Omit or pass an empty string to clear.

writeProjectDesignMd.description: Also write the design system as DESIGN.md at the project root, for tools such as Impeccable that read one. Only when the user agrees. Never overwrites: if the project already has a DESIGN.md (root, .agents/context/ or docs/), it is kept unchanged.

name: set_active_design_system
title: Set the design system
